name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-redrawn-s-world-map-graphics-pack
title: Super Mario World Redrawn's World Map Graphics Pack
description:
An updated version of Icegoom's Super Mario World's Redrawn's Overworld-inspired graphics that covers every tile previously left untouched (including but not limited to: bridges, Bowser Valley's entrance, Star World's Moon, etc.) or that was too different to SMW's own style - mostly concerning the Forest of Illusion's small and big trees.

This pack also includes different World Map graphics for redrawn Mario & Luigi, depending on whether they look like in Icegoom's original SMW Redrawn release, or in a more cartoony vibe similar-ish to how vanilla SMW depicts the brothers.

Credit goes to both me (Moltz) and Icegoom.
